incident_type.description: Category of incident the user described.

language.description: Language the reply is written in.

is_refusal.description: True if this reply is a refusal, a clarifying question or an emergency reply instead of a normal checklist.

refusal_reason.description: Reason for refusal or clarification, or null if is_refusal is false.

risk_flags.description: Elevated-risk signals: self_harm only for self-harm or suicidal thoughts; ongoing_danger when someone is an immediate threat; sextortion when intimate images or videos are used for blackmail.

message.description: Main text the user reads, 1 to 3 short sentences, in the user's language. Always filled: the direct answer, the refusal or redirect explanation, or the clarifying question.

checklist.description: Ordered, actionable steps (4 to 6) for normal guidance. Empty array if is_refusal is true.

disclaimer.description: Short reminder that this is a support tool, not a legal or emergency service.
